title: T06g — After-start health check in the update receipt
goal: Accept an update only when the started service is healthy, not just running
privacy: Neutral fixtures only in git; actual profiles, backups, credentials and deployment evidence remain private.
acceptance: After start, verify the running build commit, base identity, database integrity and that the brain and nervous processes answer; record the result in the receipt
A failed check leaves the operation uncertain with the ordered manual recovery, never a silent success
validation: Regressions through the real adapter with a fixture service; independent review; final required CI
2026-11-12: test/upgrade-health.test.ts (real macServiceAdapter + fixture /api/doctor server); fresh-context independent review (no blockers, 3 should-fix items addressed)
escalation: Any destructive restore, changed ownership or unresolved physical/worker effects requires explicit reconciliation; general restore remains F-062

effort.basis: Owner-approved split of the original T06 (4–6 focused days) into lettered slices on 2026-11-11, after the work had been delivered as unplanned slices; slices e–h use free step numbers because step IDs are two digits. Uncertain: which health signals are reliable right after start. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one. Re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0): 1.5 hours agent; former 1-day estimate at 1.5 agent hours per focused day. Method: a judged rate of about 1.5 agent hours per former focused day, not a calculation, informed by NERV merge history (50 feature and fix PRs #140–#276, previous merge to merge, a throughput proxy: median about 0.56 h, p75 2.1–2.7 h by quantile method, p90 about 5.1 h) and B-046-T02 (2-day estimate, about 0.75 h stated to implement); a step that is a PR of its own takes at least 0.75 h with review and CI, while an agent part that only prepares or records for an owner step may be less. Machine time of real-model or device runs is not counted. Estimate, not a measurement; baselineDays 1 kept as history. Re-estimated 2026-11-12 at 0.6x from `work-items calibrate` (median 0.55x over 6 closed steps; bug steps 0.6x over 5): 1.5 h → 1 h, min 0.5 h; owner hours and baseline kept. Estimate column backfilled 2026-11-12 at harness 7.0.0: estimateAgentHours = remaining plus actual so far (1 h); the baseline stays for calibration. Completed 2026-11-12 in about 0.5 h (stated: macServiceAdapter health check on /api/doctor, receipt.health and receipt.recovery on uncertain, test/upgrade-health.test.ts regressions, fresh-context independent review and 3 should-fix fixes).
